SP Leader Booked for Alleged Misconduct Towards Female Cashier

Samajwadi Party leader Rajan Rizvi has been booked in Mathura following allegations of sending inappropriate messages to a female cashier. According to reports, Rizvi allegedly told the cashier that if his government came to power, he would try to help her become an IAS officer. The FIR was registered based on a complaint filed by the cashier. The incident has reportedly put the SP leader in trouble.
